summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Watchlist persistence  **What I did before writing this plan:** read the full path end-to-end (no edits) — `WatchlistPage.tsx`, `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` + `schema.ts`, `db/auth.ts`, `modules/auth/handlers.ts`, `db/index.ts`, `client/src/lib/api.ts`, `App.tsx`/`useAuth.tsx`, and the Vite proxy config.  **What I found:** the backend is actually scoped correctly. `watchlists.user_id` is `NOT NULL`, every handler filters by it, the watchlist router's own auth middleware validates the session cookie and injects `X-User-Id` correctly, sessions are keyed off a stable
